description: HAL I2C1 (100 kHz) + PCF8574 I/O expander at 0x20: LED chaser on P0-P6 (LEDs from 3.3 V, active low) every 100 ms and a push-button on P7 read back from the port; press / release reported on USART1
expect:
72 MHz. I2C1 PB6 (SCL) / PB7 (SDA) AF open drain, 100 kHz; PCF8574 module at 0x20 on 3.3 V (its 10 kOhm SDA/SCL pull-ups). P0..P6: LED + 330 Ohm from 3.3 V into the pin; P7: push-button to GND. USART1 PA9/PA10 115200 8N1 report. After reset: 'PCF8574 chaser P0-P6, button P7 (I2C1 0x20)
'; HAL_I2C_IsDeviceReady (2 trials): no ACK -> 'no PCF8574 at 0x20
' and the core sleeps. Else every 100 ms (deadline based) one write of ~(1 << step) & 0x7F | 0x80 (one LED lit, P0 first, 7-step cycle = 700 ms) followed by a one-byte read of the port; P7 read low prints 'P7 button pressed (port 0xNN)
', high 'P7 button released (port 0xNN)
' — only on a change (the first read reports 'released' with the button open). A read of P0..P6 that differs from the written outputs prints 'port mismatch: wrote 0xWW read 0xRR' once.

circuit: PCF8574 module: not placed on this bench (the checks runner cannot place it; the chaser and the button are covered by tests/devices/comm-firmware.test.ts)
USART1: virtual terminal on PA9 (TX) / PA10 (RX)

boot.USART1:
PCF8574 chaser P0-P6, button P7 (I2C1 0x20)
no PCF8574 at 0x20
